E2908

Performance budget operation failed

What

Performance budget operation failed

Why

Provider protocol/execution, report/container, CAS, permission, or durability validation refused the operation.

Fix

Correct the named refusal and retry; there is no force bypass.

# Error [E2908]: performance budget operation failed

What: performance budget operation failed
Why: measurement provider refused the operation: provider stream has bad magic
Fix: correct the named provider failure and retry the operation
